issues.where: 1_beauty back34 and az090, rump; 2_closeups hind limb colour and wire, top right
issues.what: The rump patch is a sunken cup with a raised cream-grey rim and a dark shelf under it. The tail is a brown hook that curls down the cup's right edge, off the centre line. In az090 the rim stands off the rump outline as a pale tab with the hook beside it, and in back34 the whole thing reads as a snail shell on the rump. The heatmap is clean because nothing floats or intersects; the eye is right.
issues.fix: Stage 2: move the cup's rim and floor verts out onto the rump curve and flatten them flush (IoU > 0.9). Stage 3: paint those flush faces cream as the patch and delete the hook. Build one short wedge tail (about 8% of body length, thickness about 40% of its width) hanging on the centre line from the top of the patch, root sunk 30%, brown on top and cream underneath.
issues.check: az090: the rump outline is one unbroken curve plus a short hanging wedge. back34: one flat cream patch with the tail on the centre line. Hind limb wire: no rim and no shelf. piece_tail hit 0, sliver 0.

issues.where: 1_beauty az090 and back34, throat line; 1_beauty az000, neck at the level of the bib point; 2_closeups head colour, neck

In az000 a lone dark chip sits on the image-left edge of the neck with nothing on the right. In close-up the mane is a mottled patch with pale islands inside.
issues.fix: Stage 3, piece_mane: pull the hem tip 1-2 cm back inside the neck outline and thicken it to at least 40% of its width. Make the hem symmetric about the centre line: delete the left chip or mirror it. Repaint the mane interior one flat dark value.
issues.check: az090 and back34: a smooth throat outline with no spike. az000: the bib is symmetric. Head close-up: no pale islands in the mane. piece_mane sliver 0.

issues.fix: Stage 2: flatten the knee ring's front verts into one flat plane and pull its side verts in about 30%, so only the back of the knee bulges. Slide the forearm loops to uneven spacing, or dissolve every other one (logged).
issues.check: Front limb colour: no bead ring at either knee. Front limb wire: 3 or fewer unevenly spaced loops per forearm. IoU > 0.9.
